commands.name: A read word on this command returns the lowest 16 bits of the OperationStatus data.
SHUTDOWN Mode
commands.effect: Turns off charge/discharge FETs and enters shutdown; charger may be required to wake.

commands.name: SLEEP Mode
commands.effect: Requests sleep when sleep conditions permit.

commands.name: Device Reset (compatibility alias)
commands.effect: Resets the gauge and interrupts telemetry.

commands.name: Fuse Toggle
commands.effect: Toggles the physical FUSE output; a connected chemical fuse can open irreversibly.

commands.name: PCHG FET Toggle
commands.effect: Toggles precharge FET in manufacturing test mode.

commands.name: CHG FET Toggle
commands.effect: Toggles charge FET in manufacturing test mode.

commands.name: DSG FET Toggle
commands.effect: Toggles discharge FET in manufacturing test mode.

commands.name: Gauging
commands.effect: Toggles gauging; may persist across reset.

commands.name: FET Control
commands.effect: Toggles firmware FET control; may persist across reset.

commands.name: Permanent Failure
commands.effect: Toggles permanent-failure protection. May persist across reset.

commands.name: Fuse
commands.effect: Toggles firmware control of the fuse output. May persist across reset.

commands.name: Lifetime Data Reset
commands.effect: Erases lifetime history.

commands.name: Permanent Fail Data Reset
commands.effect: Erases permanent-failure diagnostic history.

commands.name: Black Box Recorder Reset
commands.effect: Erases black-box history.

commands.name: Seal Device
commands.effect: Seals the battery; known keys are needed to regain access.

commands.name: ROM Mode (compatibility alias)
commands.effect: Enters ROM; normal telemetry stops until ROM exit. Firmware flashing is a separate procedure.

commands.name: Security Keys
commands.effect: Reads or replaces access keys; a wrong key can prevent future access.

commands.name: Authentication Key
commands.effect: Programs the 128-bit authentication key (FULL ACCESS required). Secure-memory provisioning is a separate TI procedure.

commands.name: Device Reset
